Hi Lena / Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth and can move to concrete next steps. I captured the items we discussed and a few clarifying questions below.

Summary (recap)
- Primary business driver: reduce inference cost for our clinical summarization pipeline and ensure sub-second interactive UX for clinicians.
- Current preferred deployment: private VPC (Azure East US) because of PHI concerns. You mentioned this may be non-negotiable for now.
- Key stakeholders we heard on the call: Product (Lena Park), Head of Engineering (Tom Harris), Security (Dr. Samir Gupta), Procurement (Olivia Ramos), Economic buyer (you said CFO Mark Levin will sign off on budget).

Decision criteria we noted (please confirm or correct)
- Latency: target p95 inference <= 250ms at typical clinical prompt sizes (64–512 tokens).
- Cost: target operating cost (steady-state) — aim for <$0.30 per 1k prompt+completion tokens with reserved/dedicated sizing.
- SLA: target 99.9% uptime, and operational support window to match your hours (M–F).
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data retention and deletion controls, and KMS for key management.

Clarifying asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and their preferred engagement rhythm? (You mentioned Mark Levin.)
2) Please confirm that VPC (Azure East US) is required and whether Azure ExpressRoute / private peering is already in scope.
3) Procurement checklist: any additional docs or forms we should prepare now (NDA already done).
4) Target signature timeline: roughly 4–6 weeks after SOC2 / SLA review? Please confirm.

I attached our call notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and will follow up with a short tech-deep dive invite for next week. If that time window doesn't work, tell me two slots that do and I'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Priyom

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few confirmations and additional details from our side:

Confirmed stakeholders and roles
- Product: Lena Park (primary champion)
- Engineering: Tom Harris (decision technical lead) — tom.harris@aurionhealth.com
- Security: Dr. Samir Gupta (will own the SOC2 review and security questionnaire)
- Procurement lead: Olivia Ramos (procurement@aurionhealth.com) — will own contract language and PO steps
- Economic buyer: Mark Levin, CFO (mark.levin@aurionhealth.com) — final sign-off on pricing/term

Deployment + compliance
- VPC in Azure East US is preferred. We have private peering available (ExpressRoute) but would like to understand network requirements and estimated egress.
- SOC 2 Type II required before procurement will sign. Please send your evidence pack and an SLA sample.

Performance & cost targets (rough)
- Latency: p95 inference <= 250ms for our expected prompt sizes (majority are 64–256 tokens; some up to 512). Reasonable tolerance for longer sequences during batch jobs.
- Cost: looking for options that bring steady-state compute to under ~$12k/month for our projected throughput (happy to share numbers if you need them).

Timeline and next steps
- Procurement timeline: typically 4–6 weeks after SOC2 + SLA review. We can accelerate if Redwood provides SOC2 evidence and a clear pricing matrix this week.
- I'll coordinate scheduling: please include Tom and Samir on the technical deep dive.

I attached our procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.xlsx) to help you prepare. I'll be available for a 30–45 minute deep dive on Tue (11 May) 10–11am PT or Wed (12 May) 2–3pm PT. Which works for you and your eng lead?

Best,

Lena / team —

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Quick replies and proposed next steps from our side:

1) Tech deep-dive: Tue 11 May 10:00–10:45 PT works for us. I've invited Karthik (solutions lead) and Ben (AM) to join — Karthik will cover network/connectivity and perf expectations.

2) SOC2 and SLA: attaching a short deployment-options brief (deployment-options-brief.pdf) and a SOC2 evidence pack we can share (we'll provide the zipped evidence under NDA). We'll also prepare a sample SLA with 99.9% uptime to match your target and list of operational alerts.

3) Performance & pricing: to align on the $12k/month target, we will produce: 
   - A Reserved Capacity quote (Dedicated VPC, Azure East US) with burst/buffer options
   - A small canary plan for the first 6–8 weeks (to validate p95 numbers) and the costs for that period
   - A perf-run matrix for prompt sizes (64 / 256 / 512) with expected p95 latencies and token throughput.

4) Procurement docs: Ben will prepare the initial pricing sheet / contract consideration points. Can Olivia share any specific redlines or a template PO we should be aware of?

Next step: Confirming the tech-deep dive invite and I'll send the SOC2 pack and the initial quote before the call so Tom and Samir have time to review.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
